26 entries covering: 0xD comms-lost latch (idle + gripper-specific slow-poll variant), motor stuck 0xD surviving disable/enable (needs CLEAR_ERROR 0xFB), enable() partial-failure/joint6 re-latch, CANable reopen-after-replug on macOS (gs_usb usb.reset() re-enumeration bug, patched in can_compat.apply()), open_bus() transient 'No such device' retry/backoff, dropout-under-load bus-off-vs-arm-died diagnosis (load_dropout_test.investigate), power-loss vs signal-loss verdicts (wiggle_test/load_dropout_test), frame desync in _exchange, MotorCommunicationError (no response), MotorFaultError for each DM error code (overvoltage/undervoltage/overcurrent/over-temp/overload, deliberately NOT auto-cleared), over-70C shutdown, gripper 0xD from slow polling (monitor.py fix), gripper calibration constants (measured closed/open stops), gripper force limit (0.6Nm/41N, was 3Nm/205N), jaw-aware kinematics gripper_opening default trap, all three GuardedExecutor abort classes (torque residual / absolute torque / tracking error), waypoint-not-collision-free abort, plan_and_run.py sag-check refusal, the ~10% self-collision-in-limits trap (joint2 >105deg), command_positions step-lunge cap, diagnose.py 'adapter not found' and 'zero motors acked' (arm-side power/e-stop/termination checklist), and eduroam client-isolation needing --tunnel.

Severity split: 12 stop_the_demo (real hardware/safety faults needing operator action -- power, self-collision, overtemp, guard aborts, unpowered bus) vs 14 recoverable (software-fixable via an existing function call, already in the code).

triage.py: `--list` prints a one-line-per-entry table sorted as authored (severity, truncated symptom, primary source); `--symptom <text>` scores every entry by token-overlap (70%) + difflib ratio against the symptom text (30%), prints the best match's full cause/remedy/source plus up to 2 runner-up symptoms so a human can pick a better match if the top hit is wrong; `--validate` is the schema + file-existence smoke test, asserts on missing keys, empty strings, invalid severity enum values, and any cited .py path that does not exist under REPO_ROOT -- exits 1 with an itemized list on any failure, 0 otherwise. Manually spot-checked --symptom against '0xD comms lost latch idle' (34% top match, reasonable given many entries mention 0xD), 'canable needs replug macos No such device' (77%, correct top hit), 'dropped out while driving under load' (36%, correct top hit: load_dropout_test bus-off/arm-died triage), and 'gripper crushing object too much force' (57%, correct top hit: force-limit entry).
